apiProducts.label: Business Direct Connect
apiProducts.description: FDX-based API for J.P. Morgan commercial DDA clients: consented access to account details, balances, transactions, statements and account owner and payment network information for third-party treasury and ERP platforms.

apiProducts.label: Global Payments
apiProducts.description: Initiate multiple payment types (ACH, wire, RTP, push to card and more) across global markets through a single API. Available to J.P. Morgan Payments treasury clients.

apiProducts.label: Pay by Bank: Account Information Service
apiProducts.description: Consent-based open banking access to customer account details, balances and transaction history in the US, UK and EU.

apiProducts.label: Pay by Bank: Payment Initiation Service
apiProducts.description: Initiate payments directly from customer bank accounts in the UK and EU, with refunds and recurring mandates (UK).
